meta.title: Get Padel Jakarta — 2 Indoor Padel Courts in Pondok Kelapa
meta.description: Get Padel, Get Well. Two premium indoor padel courts in Pondok Kelapa, East Jakarta. From Rp150,000/session (includes 2 boxes of mineral water), open 06:00–22:00 daily. Book via AYO.

hero.title: Your padel court is ready. Just show up.
hero.subtitle: Two premium indoor courts with Certified Premium Turf, cold towels after play, and air-conditioned bathrooms. All levels welcome — casual games, training, and community.

location.metaTitle: Location & Venue — Get Padel Jakarta, Pondok Kelapa
location.metaDescription: Get Padel Jakarta: 2 premium indoor padel courts + Race & Rally Coffee at Billy & Moon, Pondok Kelapa, East Jakarta. Open 06:00–22:00 daily.
location.title: Play in Pondok Kelapa, East Jakarta.
location.subtitle: Two premium indoor courts inside the Billy & Moon estate — on the East Jakarta–Bekasi border. Cosy and complete: cold towels, air-conditioned bathrooms, and a coffee shop on site.
location.ctaTitle: Know the way? Time to play.
location.ctaBody: Pick your favourite slot and continue booking on the official AYO channel — the slot is held while you check out.
location.venuePhotoAlt: Get Padel Jakarta venue front at dusk in Pondok Kelapa
location.mapSubtitle: Right inside the Billy & Moon estate, Jl. Raya Kalimalang, Pondok Kelapa — easy to reach from East Jakarta and Bekasi.
location.mapCityNote: Route calculated from {city} — open it straight in Google Maps.
location.courtsSubtitle: Two identical courts — indoor, Certified Premium Turf, bright lighting, 60-minute sessions.
location.courtImageAlt: {name} photo — Get Padel Jakarta indoor padel court
location.courtBlurb: Indoor court with high-quality turf and great lighting. Ideal for social play and an energetic atmosphere.
location.facilitiesSubtitle: 12 official facilities plus extra comfort — from cold towels to power outlets at every corner.
location.facilitiesCafeNote: Race & Rally coffee shop on site — also on GoFood & GrabFood.
location.faqSubtitle: The things people ask most before playing at Get Padel.

help.metaDescription: Need help? Chat CS on WhatsApp +62 811 8802 2770, email events & partnership, or pick a quick help topic at Get Padel Jakarta.
help.title: Need a hand? We're here to help.
help.subtitle: Get Padel's reception & CS are responsive during opening hours. Pick the fastest channel, or start from the most-asked topics.
help.channelsSubtitle: All channels are active daily, following the venue's opening hours.
help.waChannelBody: Fastest — bookings, schedule, reschedules, or general questions.

help.contactSubtitle: All official contacts and venue service hours in one place.

programs.metaDescription: Private & multi-session coaching, junior classes for ages 6–9 & 10–13, free trial, tournaments & community open matches at Get Padel Jakarta, Pondok Kelapa.
programs.title: Coaching, junior classes, to open matches.
programs.subtitle: Every programme runs on Get Padel's 2 indoor courts. Bring your own coach at no extra charge — or join the classes and community sessions already available.
programs.sectionCoachingSubtitle: Private sessions with a certified coach for every level — single sessions or a better-value 5-session package.
programs.coachingNote: Bring your own coach at no extra charge.
programs.juniorSectionSubtitle: Kids' padel classes for ages 6–9 & 10–13, plus a free trial for new players. Limited spots per batch.
programs.freeTrialNote: The free-trial form opens periodically — if it's closed, register directly via WhatsApp CS.
programs.openMatchSectionSubtitle: Play with the East Jakarta–Bekasi padel community — all levels welcome. Pick a session, check the remaining spots, then join via WhatsApp.
programs.openMatchNote: Spots and schedules are maintained by the venue — confirm on WhatsApp.
programs.waMatchMessage: Hi Get Padel! I'd like to join the open match on {match}.
programs.sectionEventsSubtitle: Get Padel's community event schedule — from friendly matches to holiday celebrations.
programs.eventsEmptyBody: Tournament and community schedules are announced on Instagram @get.padel and the community WhatsApp — keep an eye out, or ask CS for the next dates.
programs.waEventMessage: Hi Get Padel! I'd like to join the {event} event.
programs.sectionPolicySubtitle: Free reschedule once — cancellations & refunds are not available. Full details below.
programs.policyAlert: In short: no refunds. Reschedule is free once, up to 5 days before your slot (members: at least 3×24 hours' notice).
programs.waProgramMessage: Hi Get Padel! I'd like to ask about the {program} program.
programs.partnershipTitle: Bring your event to Get Padel
programs.partnershipBody: Tournament with backdrop, brand/booth activation, shoot, or commercial content? Special rates outside the standard price — contact our team for availability & quotes.
programs.ctaBody: Chat CS for the next schedule, or book the court right away on AYO.
programs.openMatchEmptyBody: Session times and spots are announced by the venue on Instagram and the community WhatsApp — no sample schedule is shown here.

pricing.metaDescription: Hourly rates for Court 1 & Court 2 (weekday/weekend, peak & off-peak) plus running promos: Mandiri up to 20%, BRI 0%, Mayora snack, loyalty card, free trial, and junior classes.
pricing.title: Transparent rates, live promos.
pricing.subtitle: All rates are per 60-minute session and include 2 boxes of 240 ml mineral water. Booking & payment are processed via the official AYO channel.
pricing.rateSubtitle: Pick a day to view hourly rates. The "normal" column is the pre-discount price.
pricing.rateNoteFavorite: 18.00–22.00 on weekdays and almost every weekend slot are favourite hours — they fill up first.
pricing.rateNoteNonEvent: Rates apply to non-event use only. For events, tournaments, or commercial content, contact our team via email/WA.
pricing.promoSubtitle: Official promo posters straight from Instagram @get.padel & @racerallycoffee.
pricing.promoListSubtitle: Period, terms, and how to claim each promo.
pricing.bookingSubtitle: No registration — straight to the official AYO channel.
pricing.step1Body: Open the Schedule page and choose your favourite date and hour on Court 1 or Court 2.
pricing.step2Body: Hit "Book" and continue to the official AYO channel. No sign-up; the slot is held briefly (± 10 minutes) while you complete payment.
pricing.step3Body: Once payment succeeds, your booking confirmation is sent via email and/or the venue's official WhatsApp.
pricing.paymentSubtitle: Transactions are securely processed on the official AYO channel or directly at the venue.
pricing.paymentInstallmentNote: BRI 0% installments up to 12 months (min. Rp5 million) · Mandiri supports Power Installment & Livin' Poin redemption.
pricing.memberBody: Get Padel membership packages are only available through the AYO Indonesia app. Package prices & active vouchers are shown in the app — we don't display estimated prices.
pricing.ctaBody: Favourite slots fill up fast — secure your schedule first.
pricing.refundRowRescheduleValue: Free, once only, up to 5 days before your slot.
pricing.refundRowMemberValue: Schedule changes with max. 3×24 hours notice before the play date (subject to court availability).
pricing.refundRowTechnicalValue: Slots are replaced subject to court availability; no cash refunds.
pricing.refundRowPracticeValue: The venue may offer a full same-day refund in certain cases (has happened before).
pricing.promoCodeSubtitle: A quick reference of promo periods and copyable details.
pricing.noCodeNote: Get Padel promos apply automatically via bank cards, events, or directly at the venue — codes are only used when a promo has one.
pricing.carouselEmptyBody: The latest promo posters will appear here. In the meantime, check the promo list and terms below.
pricing.tierTitle: Pick the rate that fits your play time
pricing.tierSubtitle: All rates are per 60-minute session and already include 2 boxes of 240 ml mineral water — no hidden fees.
pricing.tierIncludes: Booking & payment are processed on the official AYO channel — transparent rates, no hidden fees.
pricing.tierFeature3: Includes 2 boxes of 240 ml mineral water
pricing.tierFeature6: Bring your own outside coach at no extra cost

checkout.metaDescription: Pick a slot, sign in, and pay securely via Midtrans. The court is locked automatically once payment succeeds.
checkout.title: Secure your court in 3 steps.
checkout.subtitle: Pick a slot from real-time official availability, sign in to keep your history, then pay securely via Midtrans — or continue through the official AYO channel.

checkout.otherCourtAvailable: {court} is still available at this time.
checkout.includes: Includes 2 boxes of 240 ml mineral water per session.
checkout.holdNote: The slot is held for ~10 minutes while you complete payment on AYO.
checkout.guestNote: No account needed. This information is only used to confirm your booking.
checkout.guestRequired: Fill in a valid name and WhatsApp number to send the booking via WhatsApp.
checkout.ayoGuestNote: The official AYO channel supports booking without an account (guest checkout).
checkout.holdTimerNote: Complete payment on AYO before time runs out. The slot hold is managed by AYO's system.
checkout.holdExpiredBody: Re-check slot availability on AYO before continuing.
checkout.paymentSectionNote: Informational only — the transaction is processed on the official AYO channel or at the venue.
checkout.payQrisDesc: Pay by scanning a QR code.
checkout.payVaDesc: Transfer via a bank Virtual Account number.
checkout.payInstallmentDesc: BRI 0% installments up to 12 months (min. Rp5 million) · Mandiri supports Power Installment & Livin' Poin redemption.

confirmation.metaDescription: Official booking confirmations are sent automatically by the AYO channel via email & WhatsApp after payment. Haven't received yours? Ask CS to resend it.
confirmation.title: Already paid? Confirmation is sent automatically.
confirmation.subtitle: Once payment succeeds on the official AYO channel, your booking confirmation is sent to the email and/or WhatsApp you used. Keep your payment receipt.
confirmation.formNote: Fill in the details below — the resend request goes to our official CS on WhatsApp. The team will check and resend the confirmation from the system.
confirmation.bookingIdPlaceholder: e.g. AYO-123456 or your order number
confirmation.resendRequired: Fill in a valid name and WhatsApp number to send the request.
confirmation.emailBody: Automatic confirmations from the booking system are sent to the email you entered at checkout.
confirmation.waBody: Some confirmations and schedule reminders arrive via the venue's official WhatsApp.
confirmation.ayoBody: The most accurate booking history and status are always available in the AYO app (orders menu).
confirmation.linkLabel: Haven't received your booking confirmation? Resend it here
